verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a one-line product-page listing, "Invoicing — Get paid faster", plus an A/R aging report in the API reference. Together these suggest Digits ships invoicing, but nothing shows how invoices are created or sent. Missing for 10: documented invoice creation and sending, online payment options on invoices (card/ACH pay links), tracking of when invoices are viewed and paid, any help-center or API documentation of an invoicing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
